transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?
For the past few years I feel worn out all the time, like I’m running on empty even when I’m not doing that much. It has just been really hard to keep up with daily life lately.
Along with feeling so worn out, have you also been feeling consistently down, sad, or empty for most of the time during these past few years?

Yes, I have. For a little over three years now, this low, heavy cloud has been hanging over me, making everything feel gray and joyless. I feel like I'm just going through the motions every day, both at work and at home.
During these past three years, have you had any periods lasting longer than two months where your mood returned to normal and you felt like your usual self?

No, I haven't had any periods like that where I felt like my normal self. This low, gray feeling has been very steady and constant over the past three years. Even when we took vacations, the heavy feeling and lack of energy never really lifted for more than a few days at a time.
Have there been times during these three years when your depression became significantly worse—to the point where you could barely function—or has it remained at a steady, milder level?

It has stayed at a very steady, flat level rather than having any sudden, severe spikes. It’s just been a constant, draining gray feeling that has dragged down my daily functioning and kept me running on empty for the last three years. I haven't had any major breakdowns, just this persistent weight that never seems to lift.
During these past three years, have you also struggled with low self-esteem, or have you frequently felt hopeless about the future?

Yes, I feel completely hopeless about the future. I constantly catch myself thinking that this flat, tired state is just how my life is going to be from now on. It feels like no vacation, job change, or even medication is ever going to make a difference.
